# Program library: coach review

These 9 programs provide exercise templates and eight weeks of planned sets, repetitions, effort targets and cardio. Seven come from the research; Build / Three Days and Home / Three Days were added on 2026-11-11 from the same methodology (B) to fill the gaps the audit names (P1.4), and need the same review. Friends already use them while the coach reviews them. Every program except a retired one is visible. Until approved, the app shows "Not reviewed by a coach yet". Approval changes the review badge, not access or past workouts. Approval requires your name, date, the exact program version and no open blockers in library/review.json. Record changes in the correction inputs and rebuild before signing off a changed version.

RIR means repetitions in reserve; RPE means rating of perceived exertion. Session tables show baseline lifting prescriptions and week 1 corrected intervals. Weekly rows override sets, RIR and cardio. Timed holds use seconds, not repetitions; their source RIR is retained in the weekly table for review.

Time estimates cover every scheduled session across all eight weeks: 8 minutes of lifting warm-up, 40 seconds per repetition-based work set or the longest hold duration, and rest after each set except the final lifting set, including rest between exercises. Cardio minutes include their own warm-up. Totals round up to 5 minutes. Estimates do not add equipment queues or double unilateral work. Check these assumptions in practice. These are planned targets, not evidence that an individual is ready to progress.

Review exercise choices, order, volume, recovery, effort, time and substitutions. Automated checks are not coaching approval. The research does not experimentally validate these individual programs.


## Foundation / Two Days

Version: 1.0.0. Review state: needs_review.

Goal: general strength and habit formation (general). Level: beginner. 2 days per week for 8 weeks.

Stated time: 45 minutes. Estimated session range: 20 to 35 minutes.

Equipment: body weight, cable, dumbbell, sled machine.

Approach: Build repetitions within the range before adding load when performance allows.

A week one reduction means one work set per exercise. Practice technique before adding load. Repeat 8-week course or progress to Foundation 3.

## Build / Four Days

Version: 1.0.0. Review state: needs_review.

Goal: muscle hypertrophy (muscle). Level: intermediate. 4 days per week for 8 weeks.

Equipment: barbell, body weight, cable, dumbbell, leverage machine, sled machine.

## Strength / Four Days

Version: 1.0.0. Review state: needs_review.

Goal: barbell strength with accessory muscle maintenance (strength). Level: intermediate. 4 days per week for 8 weeks.

Stated time: 70 minutes. Estimated session range: 30 to 60 minutes.

Equipment: barbell, body weight, cable, dumbbell, leverage machine.

Approach: Submaximal strength practice with accessory work. See the program notes for progression.

Requires prior familiarity with squat, bench, hinge patterns. Never prescribe 1RM testing; use submaximal reps. Optional strength progress uses 1-2% upper and 2-3% lower increments after two qualifying exposures.

### Squat emphasis (day 1)

Warm-up guidance: 5-8 minutes easy movement plus 2-4 progressively heavier practice sets for first primary lift; 1-2 ramp-up sets for later demanding movements. Practice sets do not count as working sets.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| barbell full squat | 4 × 3 to 5 reps | 2 | 240 seconds |  |
| barbell romanian deadlift | 3 × 5 to 8 reps | 2 | 180 seconds |  |
| dumbbell split squat | 2 × 8 to 10 reps | 2 | 120 seconds | Unilateral. |
| front plank | 3 × 30 to 60 seconds | Not prescribed | 60 seconds |  |

## Hybrid / Four Days

Version: 1.0.0. Review state: needs_review.

Goal: strength plus aerobic fitness (hybrid). Level: intermediate. 4 days per week for 8 weeks.

Stated time: 65 minutes. Estimated session range: 25 to 45 minutes.

## Conditioning / Three Days

Version: 1.0.0. Review state: needs_review.

Goal: aerobic endurance and consistency (endurance). Level: beginner, intermediate. 3 days per week for 8 weeks.

Stated time: 45 minutes. Estimated session range: 20 to 50 minutes.

Equipment: body weight, leverage machine.

Approach: Planned weekly aerobic duration changes. Tolerance still determines whether to progress.

Starting durations are capped by tolerability; if 65% baseline is too much, shorten further. Weekly duration uses cardio_scale per week, round to nearest minute. Does not replace twice-weekly resistance training for general health.

### Corrections and original values

**Controlled intervals:** Source scaled the minutes week by week (18 to 31) but kept 8 min warm-up + 4 rounds + cool-down, at least 28 min before cool-down, so weeks 1 to 5 and 8 could not be done as written (P0.1). Now the rounds change instead of the minutes: one round added every two weeks, reaching the source's 4 rounds in week 5, back to 2 in the lighter week 8. Warm-up 6 min and cool-down 4 min (beginner to intermediate). Totals stay within 2 to 3 min of the source's.

Original template: 28 min. 8 min easy + 4×(2 min RPE 7/3 min easy) + cool down; avoid maximal sprinting

## Build / Three Days

Goal: muscle hypertrophy (muscle). Level: beginner, intermediate. 3 days per week for 8 weeks.

Approach: Build repetitions within the range before adding load when performance allows.

## Home / Three Days

Version: 1.0.0. Review state: needs_review.

Goal: muscle hypertrophy (muscle). Level: any. 3 days per week for 8 weeks.

Stated time: 50 minutes. Estimated session range: 30 to 45 minutes.

Equipment: body weight, dumbbell.

Approach: Build repetitions within the range before adding load when performance allows.

For a home setup: a pair of adjustable dumbbells and a flat bench. Three full-body days with 1-3 RIR. When the heaviest dumbbells get easy, add reps up to the top of the range, slow the lowering, or move to the harder variation rather than cutting rest. Week 8 trims one set.
